title: PRP Protocol Atlas
description: A visual guide to PRP identities, discovery, HS2, topological paths, relationships, multicast, carriers and selected wire layouts. Includes the Relationship Record List (RRL) inside AOP.
alt: PRP protocol atlas: architecture flow and annotated wire fields, including SCIR, discovery, HS2, TPA, AOP and RRL.
credits: PRP editorial. Code-generated vector illustration. Specification snapshot 2026-10-24.
format_note: English poster; PDF 420 × 700 mm, PNG 2100 × 3500, scalable SVG.
technical_note: Selected layouts distinguish the AOP successor from historical wire-v4. Architectural illustration; no implementation or security certification.
